_readme: Quote-only MSC cruises. Leave pricing null. Do not add amounts. Sailings, cabins and availability are confirmed on request.

cruises.name: Island Weekend Escape
cruises.suits: A short island break for two adults sharing an inside cabin
cruises.summary: MSC Armonia, 15 or 22 January 2027. Sail from Durban to Portuguese Island and back. You make your own way to Durban.
includes: Inside cabin for two adults sharing
Meals in the main restaurants and buffet
Tea, coffee and water with meals
Daytime activities and evening entertainment
Pools, gym and kids' clubs

cruises.name: Festive Mozambique Escape
cruises.suits: A Christmas sailing for two adults sharing an inside cabin
cruises.summary: MSC Armonia, 21 to 26 December 2026. Durban, Pomene, Portuguese Island and back to Durban, with Christmas Day at sea.
includes: Inside cabin for two adults sharing
Meals in the main restaurants and buffet
Tea, coffee and water with meals
Daytime activities and evening entertainment
Pools, gym and kids' clubs

cruises.name: New Year Indian Ocean Voyage
cruises.suits: A New Year voyage for two adults sharing an inside cabin
cruises.summary: MSC Armonia, 26 December 2026 to 7 January 2027. Durban to Port Louis, La Possession and Portuguese Island, then back to Durban.
includes: Inside cabin for two adults sharing
Meals in the main restaurants and buffet
Tea, coffee and water with meals
Daytime activities and evening entertainment
Pools, gym and kids' clubs

cruises.name: Family Island Adventure
cruises.suits: Families. Two adults share an inside cabin, and children's places are confirmed when you enquire
cruises.summary: MSC Armonia on 18 January 2027, with 11 and 25 January also possible. Durban to Pomene and back. Kids' clubs are on board.
includes: Inside cabin for two adults sharing
Meals in the main restaurants and buffet
Tea, coffee and water with meals
Daytime activities and evening entertainment
Pools, gym and kids' clubs
cruises.note: Tell us the ages of any children so we can confirm their places.

cruises.name: Couples Balcony Getaway
cruises.summary: MSC Armonia, 18 December 2026. A short sail from Durban to Portuguese Island and back, in a balcony cabin.
includes: Balcony cabin for two adults sharing
Meals in the main restaurants and buffet
Tea, coffee and water with meals
Daytime activities and evening entertainment
Pools, gym and kids' clubs

cruises.name: Phalaborwa Sail-Away
cruises.duration: 3 nights, plus a night in Durban
cruises.suits: Guests travelling from Phalaborwa who want the island weekend with the travel arranged
cruises.summary: The 3-night Portuguese Island cruise on MSC Armonia, 15 or 22 January 2027, in an inside cabin. We add a night in Durban before you sail, and transfers to the ship. Flights or the drive from Phalaborwa are part of the quote.
includes: Inside cabin for two adults sharing
A night in Durban before embarkation
Transfers to the ship
Meals on board in the main restaurants and buffet
Tea, coffee and water with meals
Daytime activities, evening entertainment, pools, gym and kids' clubs
cruises.note: Travel from Phalaborwa is confirmed with the cruise. We do not hold a sailing until MSC confirms it.

cruises.name: Atlantic Coast Escape
cruises.suits: Two adults sharing an inside cabin, sailing from Cape Town
cruises.summary: MSC Armonia, 21 to 26 March 2027. Cape Town to Walvis Bay and back. Flights to Cape Town are quoted with the cruise if you are not already there.
includes: Inside cabin for two adults sharing
Meals in the main restaurants and buffet
Tea, coffee and water with meals
Daytime activities and evening entertainment
Pools, gym and kids' clubs

cruises.name: First-Timer Sea Break
cruises.suits: First-time cruisers who want a short sea break, two adults sharing an inside cabin
cruises.summary: MSC Armonia, 12 to 14 February 2027. A two-night cruise that leaves Durban and returns to Durban, with no port stop. There is one departure this season.
includes: Inside cabin for two adults sharing
Meals in the main restaurants and buffet
Tea, coffee and water with meals
Daytime activities and evening entertainment
Pools, gym and kids' clubs
